svg.title: signed-symmetry invariant scalar u, the tensor Jab = δabu belongs to the classified free stress space. Its coordinate trace is 4w01+4(w1+4w2)Oscale = 4u. Thus scalar membership follows. Expectation kills Oscale and fixes the unit; its nonzero free two-point norm then proves the scalar coordinate map injective. Inverse scaling preserves those real symmetries and membership. The physical detector is exactly (KiT)a = Bir5 i U−1 i,5 ((div T)a). (TR49)
